styleSuffix: Raw, uncooked, premium quality, with only a faint frosty sheen (not buried in ice). Placed on a seamless pure absolute black background (#000000): no table, no surface, no gradient, no vignette, no colored backdrop, no reflections. Dramatic soft studio lighting: large softbox key light from the upper left, a subtle cool rim light along the edges, realistic moist texture and highlights. Subject centered, filling about 65% of the frame width, with generous pure black margin on all four sides, the entire subject fully inside the frame, 3/4 high camera angle, tack sharp, ultra detailed, photorealistic. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no packaging, no plates, no bowls, no props, no hands, no garnish, no herbs, no lemon, no ice cubes.
